title: Drought on the Alföld and 21st-Century Water Strategy
grammar: Synthesizing causal (következtében, hatására) and purposive chains (érdekében, végett) in environmental policy
goal: I can evaluate the acute challenges of climate change, desertification, and water retention on Hungary's Great Plain (Alföld).
I can integrate complex causal and purposive postpositional structures into professional environmental policy essays.
I can debate modern landscape water retention (vízvisszatartás) versus historic drainage strategies in Hungarian.
